style: Say brightly and clearly, like an upbeat lab instructor who loves a good measurement.
lines: Pick an apparatus. Change the bath or the weights, then press Record to log a row.
More weight, more pressure. Watch the gas shrink until it pushes back equally.
Press Fit line to draw the best straight line through your rows.
Use four bath settings spanning at least 60 degrees. Press Record at each, then open Notebook to compare your measurements.
Now change one thing: the gas, the amount or the weights. Record a second set and fit it.
Your line meets zero near minus 273 degrees Celsius.
The piston hit the stop. Now the pressure climbs instead.
A real can could burst. The gauge stops here.
